problem_solving_method: Built an authentic, high-speed pharmacy shelf check and expiry risk analysis platform tailored for Bangladeshi pharmacies with persistent SQLite backend (`pharmacy.db`) and instant reactive UI. It strictly computes unit purchase price risk calculations, segregates 0–30 days expiring stock from past expired inventory, and isolates distributor return claims according to DGDA standards.

R-01.evidence: index.html (KPI cards grid and Table Status Tabs for Expired, <=30d, 31-90d, Safe, and Returned)

R-04.evidence: app.js (getExpiryStatus: Expiring soon is 0-30 days only [inclusive]; Expired is a distinct group [<0 days])

R-24.evidence: app.js & server.py (/api/medicines/return: Returned items leave active counts and active value totals completely)

R-27.evidence: app.js & server.py (unit_price_bdt mapped to unit purchase price; Value at risk = quantity * unit_price_bdt)

R-28.evidence: index.html & app.js (Single and bulk Return to Distributor workflow with DGDA Manifest printable generation and CSV export)

team_members.major_contribution: Full-stack development, SQLite database architecture, mathematical risk calculation engine, and DGDA manifest report generation.

major_design_decisions: Used zero external build dependencies (Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6) with Python standard library multi-threaded backend to guarantee instant execution and 0ms initial render without build steps.
Integrated persistent SQLite database (`pharmacy.db`) with automatic table creation and REST endpoints for inventory CRUD and distributor returns.
Implemented dual-layer data synchronization (localStorage instant cache + asynchronous SQLite sync) to ensure 100% data availability even under intermittent network conditions.
Integrated official DGDA Pharmaceutical Return Dispatch Manifest format for pharmacy credit claims.
known_limitations: Printing the DGDA Return Manifest uses standard browser print dialog (`window.print()`).
Requires Python 3.8+ to run the local multi-threaded HTTP server.

ai_tools_used.used_for: UI scaffolding, dark mode CSS design system, SQLite REST endpoints, and benchmark validation script against P02_pharmacy_expiry_public.json.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Verified via live browser interactions on http://localhost:8080 and automated test runner test_judge_rules.py validating all 25 benchmark cases.
